change_under_test: Runtime-local scalar caching and cached native GELU integration, uncommitted on the base revision
diagnostic_overrides: In encoder_tensor, prefix the fused GeGLU condition with false && to select the native split/GELU/multiply composition.
In the model's gelu_erf_cached helper, prefix the CPU extension condition with false && to select cached native GELU at all activation sites.
coverage: Production Julia input IDs, logits and action scores within the existing 2e-3 + abs(expected)*2e-5 tolerance, plus decision and system-one answer assertions.
limitations: CPU evidence only. Other model operations retain their standard CPU dispatch. This does not prove GPU cache residency, full GPU model parity or latency improvement.
